matchup.plan_md:
**Council verdict** (`council/sessions/20261101-040000-second-stream-slot.json`): stream VanVleet's slot and **Anthony Black's** slot. The vote was unanimous, 19 of 19, in the opening round.

As rostered we project **1,447 to 1,487**. The six-add plan adds +161.1, so we finish on 1,608 in our lineup against their 1,487 as rostered. Melbourne poopoo made four adds in the first matchup, so expect their total to rise.

**The moves** (*Best plan* below; each is due by the earlier tip-off of the two players that day):

| # | US day | Deadline, Melbourne (ET) | Move |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Wed 4 | **1:00 pm Thu 5** (9:00 pm Wed) | Drop Anthony Black, add **Collin Gillespie** (PHX) |
| 2 | Thu 5 | **1:00 pm Fri 6** (9:00 pm Thu) | Drop Fred VanVleet, add **Dillon Brooks** (PHX) |
| 3 | Fri 6 | **11:30 am Sat 7** (7:30 pm Fri) | Drop Brooks, add **Peyton Watson** (CLE) |
| 4 | Fri 6 | **12:00 pm Sat 7** (8:00 pm Fri) | Drop Gillespie, add **Alex Caruso** (OKC) |
| 5 | Sun 8 | **11:30 am Mon 9** (7:30 pm Sun) | Drop Watson, add **Daniel Gafford** (DAL) |
| 6 | Sun 8 | **1:00 pm Mon 9** (9:00 pm Sun) | Drop Caruso, add **Yves Missi** (NO) |

**Form of everyone in the plan:**

| Player | Season (GP) | L7 | L15 | L30 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Black | 36.0 (3) | 36.0 (3) | 36.0 (3) | 36.0 (3) |
| VanVleet | 35.4 (5) | 31.3 (3) | 35.4 (5) | 35.4 (5) |
| Gillespie | 31.5 (4) | 40.3 (3) | 31.5 (4) | 31.5 (4) |
| Brooks | 29.2 (4) | 36.3 (3) | 29.2 (4) | 29.2 (4) |
| Watson | 27.0 (6) | 30.0 (5) | 27.0 (6) | 27.0 (6) |
| Caruso | 30.8 (4) | 34.5 (2) | 30.8 (4) | 30.8 (4) |
| Gafford | 32.8 (6) | 39.0 (4) | 32.8 (6) | 32.8 (6) |
| Missi | 41.5 (2) | — | 41.5 (2) | 41.5 (2) |

All of these are small samples.

**Reasons behind the L7 swings:**
- **Gillespie** (+8.8): 16 points, 10 assists and 4 steals in 33 minutes on 30 Oct.
- **Brooks** (+7.1): 22 points in 21 minutes before his ejection.
- **Gafford** (+6.2): 18 points on 6-of-7 on 30 Oct.
- **Caruso**'s L7 and **Missi**'s season are 2 games each, so they are noise.

**Fallbacks:**
- **If Caruso is not cleared by Friday, or Brooks is suspended, use the 4-add plan (+115.6).** It uses neither of them:
  - Thu: VanVleet → Gillespie.
  - Fri: Gillespie → Watson.
  - Sun: Watson → Gafford, and Black → Missi.
- **Missi** has no timetable reported (*ESPN est.* 8 Nov). If he isn't cleared by Sunday, take Sunday's best streamer from the matchup report instead.

**Today, Sun 1 Nov US:** matchup 2 is lost (1,230–1,550 with one day left). Its 2 spare adds can make move 1 now, Black → Gillespie, without touching matchup 3's 6.
- A `--swap` run puts that version at 1,614 against the plan's 1,608, a wash. It does lock in Gillespie early.
- It gives up Black's Sunday game, which only counts in the matchup we have already lost.

**Lineups:** Monday is overfull with 12 of ours for 10 slots, so sit Trey Murphy III and Desmond Bane. After Monday, start everyone with a game.

**Watch for:**
- **Dejounte Murray** (ours): personal leave, no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 2 Nov. If he misses Monday, Murphy or Bane plays in his place.
- **Kawhi Leonard** (ours): re-evaluated about 3 Nov, "3-4 weeks" (Haynes); *ESPN est.* 23 Nov.
- **Jalen Duren** (ours, IR): possible return about 9 Nov; *ESPN est.* 9 Nov.
- **Ty Jerome** (theirs): upper-back soreness, no timetable reported; *ESPN est.* 2 Nov.
- **Anthony Edwards** (theirs): out after knee surgery; *ESPN est.* 21 Dec.

### Notes

- **VanVleet is not injured.** He rested Saturday on the second night of a back-to-back [Field Level Media, 31 Oct](https://fieldlevelmedia.com/nba/jabari-smith-jr-rockets-overwhelm-undermanned-thunder/). Houston has no back-to-back this week, so he plays Mon, Wed and Sat.
- **Black's role** is tied to Suggs (re-evaluated about 9 Nov; *ESPN est.* 10 Nov) and Banchero (4–6 weeks; *ESPN est.* 22 Nov). Rotoworld says to hold him "until Suggs returns" (`docs/research/20261101-0400-second-stream-slot.md`).
- **Brooks** was ejected on 30 Oct with a Flagrant 2, which is under league review. **Caruso** is "likely to be out for several games" [Yahoo Sports, 31 Oct](https://sports.yahoo.com/nba/article/thunders-chet-holmgren-will-miss-8-10-weeks-after-undergoing-treatment-on-patellar-tendon-tear-010736245.html). **Missi** is week-to-week (briefing).
- **Gafford** starts while Lively is a game-time decision (*ESPN est.* 2 Nov). **Gillespie** is a bench guard who played 33 minutes on 30 Oct (briefing).
